name: Tara Mallen
bio: Tara Mallen is an award winning actor, director, and the Producing Artistic Director at Chicago's acclaimed Rivendell Theatre Ensemble. Her screen credits include the 2023 Sundance Breakout Ghostlight, The Last Shift, Steven Soderbergh's Contagion, and the indie feature Fools, as well as TV appearances on Dark Matter (Apple TV), Empire (Fox); BOSS (Starz), Chicago Fire and Chicago P.D. (NBC), Sense8 (Netflix) the pilot Doubt (CBS/Sony). She was recently featured in the 2023 Coca Cola commercial "New Guy" directed by Chris Storer.

credits.title: Mouse
credits.overview: In 2002 Arkansas, Callie and Minnie’s friendship is suddenly upended the summer before their senior year of high school. Left rudderless without her best friend, Minnie forms a complicated bond with Callie’s mother.

credits.title: Vespers
credits.overview: Adrift after her Unitarian Universalist church is firebombed, a Midwestern woman attempts to welcome two promoters renting out the congregation’s basement for a DIY punk gig.

credits.title: Winter Hymns
credits.overview: A palliative care doctor meets with a series of dying patients.

credits.title: Ghostlight
credits.overview: When melancholic construction worker Dan finds himself drifting from his wife and daughter, he discovers community and purpose in a local theater's production of Romeo and Juliet. As the drama onstage starts to mirror his own life, he and his family are forced to confront a personal loss.

credits.title: The Last Shift
credits.overview: Stanley, an aging fast food worker, prepares to work his final graveyard shift after 38 years. When he's asked to train his replacement, Jevon, Stanley's weekend takes an unexpected turn.

credits.title: Fools
credits.overview: Two strangers brush hands on a train and move in together days later, fabricating the history of their love as they go along.

credits.title: Contagion
credits.overview: As an epidemic of a lethal airborne virus - that kills within days - rapidly grows, the worldwide medical community races to find a cure and control the panic that spreads faster than the virus itself.
